flags.observation: "the verdict precedes the witness" pre-empts the Queen's card and stays literary; the frame carries little satirical provocation about the deck concept.
"Gaslight, a fading grin." keeps the power label as a bare tag; rule labels are to be dropped, power only as aside.
Line ends on the rule label "Narcolepsy." and carries no artwork image; the Dormouse in the teapot is absent.
"Dodo, pigeon, serpent, galaxy belly" is an image inventory, not one real picture; the Visitor gets no want or grudge.
"discarded cupboards, clocks, marmalade jar fall" fuses the power's discarded cards into the image; cupboards are never discarded on the card.
"time loop, repeat the last sentence" recites label plus rule mechanics; reads like a rulebook line read aloud.
"Giant can intimidate the King. Eat Me cake, the Giant grows." uses the game state Giant twice and recites the power as rule.
"Micro hides inside the other bottle": card says other cards, so the second bottle is a new image; Micro is a game state term.
"Topic closed:" does not follow from the Mushroom before it and only echoes the card's own ending; no therefore or but.
"Slate, SCREECH, screech." doubles the same word as filler; the line closes on noise, not on the card's claim.
"sticky trap, cannot leave" states label and mechanic directly; the Treacle Well has no character, only a rule effect.
"Who Stole the Tarts?, prove innocence or guilt" stacks question mark and comma; the breath stalls mid-line before the clause.
